speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: The abdominal ultrasound demonstrates significant dilation of the stomach and proximal duodenum with a cutoff in the second or third portion of the duodenum, consistent with the "double bubble" sign. No distal bowel gas is visualized, and there is no evidence of meconium ileus or other distal obstruction.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia

The ultrasound findings of the "double bubble" sign with a cutoff in the duodenum and no distal gas are classic for this condition. In a newborn with bilious vomiting, this confirms an obstruction at the duodenum, most commonly due to duodenal atresia.
